WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, 
         SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scancount,
         SUM(sc.gbsize) / SUM(sc.spanmin) as rate
  FROM scans sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT sr.healtheval, 
       sr.total_scancount, 
       sr.rate,
       sr.rate - ar.avg_rate as rate_minus_avg
FROM status_rates sr
CROSS JOIN avg_rate ar
WHERE sr.rate > ar.avg_rate
ORDER BY sr.healtheval
